meaning.en: Not based on real conditions; disconnected from how things actually are.
meaning.zh: 与实际情况不符，不切实际。

examples.zh: 这份计划脱离实际，根本无法执行。
examples.en: The plan is divorced from reality and simply cannot be carried out.

examples.zh: 教材内容不能脱离实际生活。
examples.en: Teaching materials must not be cut off from real life.

usage.en: Predicate; often criticises plans, theories or leaders.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常批评计划、理论或领导。

meaning.en: Still very young; used to stress that someone is young for what they have done or are doing.
meaning.zh: 年龄还很小，常用来强调与其年纪不相称的事。

examples.zh: 他年纪轻轻就当上了厂长。
examples.en: He became factory director at such a young age.

examples.zh: 你年纪轻轻的，怎么这么消极？
examples.en: You're so young; why so negative?

usage.en: Usually sets up a contrast: 年纪轻轻就…; can be admiring or reproachful. 轻轻 is read qīng qīng.
usage.zh: 常引出对比（年纪轻轻就……），可表赞赏也可表责备。

literal: real work · makes prosper · the nation
natural: hard work makes the nation thrive

meaning.en: Real work, not empty talk, makes a country prosper.
meaning.zh: 踏实做事才能使国家兴盛。

equivalents: action, not talk, makes a country strong

examples.zh: 实干兴邦，空谈误国，这是历史的经验。
examples.en: Practical work builds a nation and empty talk ruins it; so history teaches.

examples.zh: 会议强调要实干兴邦，不要搞形式主义。
examples.en: The meeting stressed that action is what strengthens the nation, not formalism.

usage.en: A slogan, usually paired with 空谈误国; official and editorial register.
usage.zh: 口号式用语，常与“空谈误国”并用，多见于官方和评论文章。

meaning.en: To welcome capable people from all quarters into one's service.
meaning.zh: 广泛地吸收有才能的人。

equivalents: open the door to able people

examples.zh: 公司欲广纳贤才，扩大研发团队。
examples.en: The company wants to recruit talent widely to enlarge its R&D team.

examples.zh: 一个好的领导者懂得广纳贤才。
examples.en: A good leader knows how to bring in able people from all sides.

usage.en: Verb phrase; used in recruitment and leadership contexts. 广纳人才 is the plainer variant.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多见于招聘和领导者的语境；“广纳人才”更平实。

literal: on the verge of · going bankrupt

meaning.en: Close to going bankrupt.
meaning.zh: 接近破产的边缘。

examples.zh: 这家老字号濒临破产，亟待转型。
examples.en: The old brand is on the brink of bankruptcy and urgently needs to change.

examples.zh: 疫情让许多小餐馆濒临破产。
examples.en: The pandemic pushed many small restaurants to the edge of bankruptcy.

usage.en: Predicate, common in business and financial news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于经济新闻。

meaning.en: Taking the imperial examinations again and again without passing.
meaning.zh: 多次参加科举考试都没有考中。

equivalents: fail the exams time and again

examples.zh: 蒲松龄屡试不第，晚年才补了个贡生。
examples.en: Pu Songling failed the exams repeatedly and was only made a senior licentiate late in life.

examples.zh: 他屡试不第，终于放弃了科举。
examples.en: After failing exam after exam, he finally gave up on the civil service route.

usage.en: Historical register, about the imperial exams; now sometimes used jokingly of any exam. 第 means to pass.
usage.zh: 历史色彩，指科举考试；现在有时也戏用于各种考试。

meaning.en: Spending one's later years in loneliness and poverty.
meaning.zh: 晚年生活孤独、困苦。

equivalents: a lonely and miserable old age
end one's days in bleak circumstances

examples.zh: 他年轻时风光无限，晚景凄凉。
examples.en: In youth he was at the top, but his old age was bleak.

examples.zh: 没有子女照顾，老人晚景凄凉。
examples.en: With no children to look after him, the old man's last years were desolate.

usage.en: Predicate; often in life stories and obituaries.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于人物传记和回忆。

meaning.en: A whole scene brimming with life and vigour.
meaning.zh: 到处是充满活力的景象。

examples.zh: 春天到了，田野里一派生机。
examples.en: Spring has come and the fields are full of life.

examples.zh: 改造后的老街一派生机。
examples.en: The renovated old street is bustling with life.

usage.en: Predicate or start of a clause describing a scene; 派 is a measure word for scenes. 机 as in 生机.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，描写景象；“派”是量词。

meaning.en: To achieve good results once more.
meaning.zh: 又取得好成绩。

examples.zh: 预祝我校运动员在比赛中再创佳绩！
examples.en: We wish our school's athletes fresh success in the competition!

examples.zh: 公司今年销售额再创佳绩。
examples.en: The company's sales set a fresh record this year.

usage.en: Common in news, speeches and congratulations; often a wish.
usage.zh: 常见于新闻、讲话和祝愿语，多用作祝福。

meaning.en: Prices of goods rising very rapidly.
meaning.zh: 商品价格上涨得很快。

examples.zh: 物价飞涨，普通家庭压力很大。
examples.en: With prices soaring, ordinary families are under great pressure.

examples.zh: 那几年物价飞涨，工资跟不上。
examples.en: In those years prices soared and wages could not keep up.

usage.en: Subject + predicate in one phrase; common in economic news.
usage.zh: 主谓结构，常见于经济新闻。

meaning.en: Having great confidence in a coming task or result.
meaning.zh: 对事情的成功很有把握。

examples.zh: 面对明天的面试，她信心十足。
examples.en: She is full of confidence for tomorrow's interview.

examples.zh: 球队信心十足地走上赛场。
examples.en: The team walked onto the pitch confident of winning.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (信心十足地); 足 reads zú.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（信心十足地）。

meaning.en: Passed around among many people over a wide area.
meaning.zh: 在很大范围里被很多人传说或传播。

examples.zh: 这个故事在民间广为流传。
examples.en: The story is widely told among ordinary people.

examples.zh: 他的歌曲在网上广为流传。
examples.en: His songs circulate widely online.

usage.en: Predicate; 为 is read wéi (passive marker). Appears for stories, rumours, songs, news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“为”读wéi，表被动，常用于故事、谣言、歌曲等。

meaning.en: Heavy snow blocking the mountain paths and cutting off passage.
meaning.zh: 大雪覆盖山路，使人无法通行。

examples.zh: 大雪封山，车辆无法通行。
examples.en: Heavy snow has closed the mountain; no vehicles can get through.

examples.zh: 每到冬天，大雪封山，村里人就很少出门。
examples.en: Each winter the snow shuts off the mountain and villagers seldom go out.

usage.en: A subject-verb-object phrase, used as a clause; typical of weather news and rural life.
usage.zh: 主谓宾结构，可作分句，常见于天气报道和山区生活描写。

meaning.en: To refuse to accept responsibility and put it on someone else.
meaning.zh: 不肯承担责任，把责任推给别人。

examples.zh: 出了问题，他第一反应就是推卸责任。
examples.en: When something goes wrong, his first reaction is to pass the buck.

examples.zh: 领导不能遇事就推卸责任。
examples.en: Leaders must not shirk responsibility whenever trouble comes.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase, critical; 卸 is read xiè.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，含贬义；“卸”读xiè。

meaning.en: Not being swayed by persuasion, temptation or pressure.
meaning.zh: 不被说服、诱惑或压力所影响。

examples.zh: 无论对方怎么劝说，他都不为所动。
examples.en: However they tried to persuade him, he remained unmoved.

examples.zh: 面对高薪诱惑，她不为所动。
examples.en: She was not tempted by the high salary.

usage.en: Predicate; 为…所 is a passive pattern, 为 read wéi. Praise or criticism depending on context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“为……所”为被动格式，“为”读wéi，褒贬视语境而定。

literal: not the slightest · not · leave · mercy

meaning.en: Showing no leniency or sympathy at all.
meaning.zh: 一点也不讲情面，不手软。

examples.zh: 评委对这支乐队的表现毫不留情地批评了一番。
examples.en: The judges criticised the band's performance without mercy.

examples.zh: 他毫不留情地拒绝了对方的请求。
examples.en: He turned down the request without a moment's mercy.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (毫不留情地) or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作状语（毫不留情地）或谓语。

meaning.en: To let time slip away without achieving anything.
meaning.zh: 白白地把时间浪费掉，什么也没做成。

examples.zh: 青春宝贵，不要虚度光阴。
examples.en: Youth is precious; don't waste it.

examples.zh: 他整天玩游戏，虚度光阴。
examples.en: He spends all day gaming and lets time slip by.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase, often in advice; 光阴 is read guāng yīn.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于劝勉；“光阴”读guāng yīn。

antonyms: 少年易老学难成，一寸光阴不可轻

meaning.en: To investigate who is to blame and make them answer for it.
meaning.zh: 查明谁该负责，并让他承担后果。

examples.zh: 事故发生后，有关部门将依法追究责任。
examples.en: After the accident, the authorities will hold those responsible to account by law.

examples.zh: 公司表示一定追究责任，绝不姑息。
examples.en: The company says it will hold those responsible to account and will show no leniency.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase, common in news and official notices.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于新闻和通知。

meaning.en: To show up without having been invited.
meaning.zh: 没有人邀请，自己就来了。

examples.zh: 他是个不请自来的客人，大家都有些尴尬。
examples.en: He was an uninvited guest, and everyone felt a little awkward.

examples.zh: 好机会不会不请自来，要自己去争取。
examples.en: Good chances do not come uninvited; you must go after them.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (不请自来的客人); can be mildly critical or humorous. 不请自到 is a variant.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（不请自来的客人），略带批评或幽默；“不请自到”为异形。

synonyms: 孙悟空赴蟠桃会——不请自到

meaning.en: Heavy snow swirling down in the air.
meaning.zh: 大雪一片片从空中飘落。

examples.zh: 窗外大雪纷飞，屋里却很温暖。
examples.en: Snow swirled outside the window, but the room was warm.

examples.zh: 那天大雪纷飞，路上几乎没有行人。
examples.en: That day the snow came down thick, and there were hardly any pedestrians on the road.

usage.en: Predicate or clause in descriptions of winter scenes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或分句，用于描写冬景。

literal: simple and clear · easy · to understand

meaning.en: Simple and clear enough to be understood without difficulty.
meaning.zh: 内容简单明白，容易理解。

examples.zh: 这本书讲得浅显易懂，适合初学者。
examples.en: The book is clear and easy to follow, so it suits beginners.

examples.zh: 医生用浅显易懂的话解释了病情。
examples.en: The doctor explained the condition in plain terms.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (浅显易懂的语言); 浅显 means simple and obvious.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（浅显易懂的语言）。

meaning.en: To carry something out in full, not watering it down.
meaning.zh: 完全照办，不打折扣地执行。

examples.zh: 各项规定要不打折扣地执行。
examples.en: Every rule must be carried out in full.

examples.zh: 他对工作的要求从不打折扣。
examples.en: He never lowers his standards at work.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (不打折扣地 + verb), as in policy language; also a plain shopping meaning in other contexts.
usage.zh: 多作状语（不打折扣地＋动词），常见于政策用语；在购物语境也有字面义。

meaning.en: Singing that is loud, clear and carries far.
meaning.zh: 唱歌的声音洪亮清脆，传得很远。

examples.zh: 操场上歌声嘹亮，同学们在排练合唱。
examples.en: Voices rang out across the playground as the class rehearsed the chorus.

examples.zh: 她歌声嘹亮，一开口全场都安静了。
examples.en: Her voice is clear and powerful; the hall fell silent the moment she began.

usage.en: Predicate or clause; 嘹亮 is read liáo liàng.
usage.zh: 作谓语或分句；“嘹亮”读liáo liàng。

meaning.en: All things that exist in the world.
meaning.zh: 世界上所有的事物。

examples.zh: 世间万物都在不断变化。
examples.en: Everything in the world is constantly changing.

examples.zh: 他用镜头记录世间万物的美。
examples.en: He uses his camera to record the beauty of all things.

usage.en: Mostly subject or object in reflective or philosophical remarks.
usage.zh: 多作主语或宾语，用于哲理或感慨。

meaning.en: Born into a family of high standing or fame.
meaning.zh: 出生在有名望的家族。

examples.zh: 她出身名门，却一点没有架子。
examples.en: She comes from a distinguished family, yet has no airs.

examples.zh: 这位出身名门的画家在国外也很有名。
examples.en: The painter, from a well-known family, is famous abroad as well.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; neutral to slightly admiring.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，中性或略带艳羡。

natural: able to advance or retreat at will

meaning.en: Able to act or draw back freely as the situation requires.
meaning.zh: 前进、后退都很灵活，应付得当。

examples.zh: 他在谈判中进退自如，让对手无从下手。
examples.en: In the negotiations he moved easily between pressing and giving way, leaving the other side no opening.

examples.zh: 这套战术让球队进退自如。
examples.en: The tactics let the team switch between attack and defence at will.

usage.en: Predicate; compare 进退两难, the opposite predicament.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；与处境相反的“进退两难”对照。

meaning.en: To bring about one's own ruin by one's own actions.
meaning.zh: 自己做出会导致失败或死亡的事。

examples.zh: 明知有危险还要去冒险，简直是自寻死路。
examples.en: Going on despite knowing the danger is simply asking for it.

examples.zh: 他不听劝告，等于自寻死路。
examples.en: By ignoring all advice he is walking himself to ruin.

usage.en: Predicate; strong and usually a warning.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，语气较重，多含警告意味。

meaning.en: Cruel, with no pity or feeling.
meaning.zh: 手段狠毒，没有一点同情心。

examples.zh: 敌人残忍无情，村子被洗劫一空。
examples.en: The enemy was merciless and the village was stripped bare.

examples.zh: 他对待动物残忍无情。
examples.en: He is cruel and heartless towards animals.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly negative.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，贬义强烈。

meaning.en: To think very hard to find a solution.
meaning.zh: 想了很多办法，用了很多心思。

examples.zh: 为了凑够学费，他费尽脑筋。
examples.en: He racked his brains to scrape together the tuition fee.

examples.zh: 老师费尽脑筋让课堂变得有趣。
examples.en: The teacher racked her brains to make lessons interesting.

usage.en: Predicate, often followed by a verb phrase; more colloquial than 费尽心思.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后常接动词短语；比“费尽心思”更口语。

meaning.en: Very worried and impatient.
meaning.zh: 非常着急。

examples.zh: 孩子一夜未归，父母焦急万分。
examples.en: The child had not come home all night and the parents were frantic.

examples.zh: 得知航班取消，他焦急万分。
examples.en: When he heard the flight was cancelled, he was beside himself with worry.

usage.en: Predicate; 万分 intensifies, as in 感激万分.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“万分”表程度极深，如“感激万分”。

meaning.en: To take the lead in defending what is right.
meaning.zh: 站出来维护公道。

examples.zh: 法官应该主持正义，不偏不倚。
examples.en: A judge should uphold justice and be impartial.

examples.zh: 路人主持正义，帮老人讨回了钱包。
examples.en: A passer-by stood up for what is right and got the old man's wallet back.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; fairly formal. 主持 here means to uphold.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，较正式；“主持”在此指主张、维护。

meaning.en: Having no worries at all.
meaning.zh: 一点烦恼和担心也没有。

equivalents: without a worry in the world

examples.zh: 住在这里，他毫无忧虑，每天读书喝茶。
examples.en: Living here he has not a worry and spends his days reading and drinking tea.

examples.zh: 孩子们毫无忧虑地在草地上玩耍。
examples.en: The children played carefree on the grass.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (毫无忧虑地).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（毫无忧虑地）。

meaning.en: The mountains are steep and dangerous to climb.
meaning.zh: 山很陡，地势险要。

examples.zh: 这里山势险峻，登山者必须格外小心。
examples.en: The mountains here are precipitous, so climbers must take extra care.

examples.zh: 华山山势险峻，自古有“天下第一险”之称。
examples.en: Mount Hua is so steep that since ancient times it has been called the most perilous in the land.

usage.en: Predicate; subject-predicate phrase for terrain description. 峻 is read jùn.
usage.zh: 主谓结构，多作谓语，描写地形；“峻”读jùn。

meaning.en: Having a generous mind that tolerates and embraces a lot.
meaning.zh: 气量大，包容性强。

examples.zh: 他胸襟宽广，能容下不同的声音。
examples.en: His mind is broad, and he can accommodate dissenting voices.

examples.zh: 母亲胸襟宽广，从不记仇。
examples.en: Mother is magnanimous and never holds a grudge.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; slightly more literary than 心胸开阔.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，比“心胸开阔”稍书面。

meaning.en: Deceitful and crafty, ready to cheat others.
meaning.zh: 阴险欺诈，诡计多端。

examples.zh: 这个商人奸诈狡猾，大家都不愿与他合作。
examples.en: The merchant is sly and deceitful and nobody wants to deal with him.

examples.zh: 狐狸在故事里常被写成奸诈狡猾的形象。
examples.en: In stories the fox is often shown as sly and crafty.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly negative.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，贬义强烈。

meaning.en: To run away looking panicked and defeated.
meaning.zh: 慌乱而难堪地逃走。

examples.zh: 小偷被发现后狼狈逃跑。
examples.en: The thief ran off in a panic once he was spotted.

examples.zh: 对手被打得狼狈逃跑。
examples.en: The opponents were beaten and fled in disarray.

usage.en: Verb phrase; 狼狈 is read láng bèi.
usage.zh: 动词性短语；“狼狈”读láng bèi。

meaning.en: To learn from a mistake or failure so as not to repeat it.
meaning.zh: 从错误或失败中学到经验，避免再犯。

examples.zh: 我们要吸取教训，不能再犯同样的错误。
examples.en: We must learn the lesson and not repeat the same mistake.

examples.zh: 事故之后，厂里认真吸取教训，加强了安全检查。
examples.en: After the accident the factory took the lesson to heart and tightened safety checks.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; common in news, meetings and parental advice.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于新闻、会议和家长的告诫。

meaning.en: Being keen on lavish display and a grand scale of events.
meaning.zh: 注重场面铺张、气派。

examples.zh: 他办婚礼特别讲究排场，花了几十万。
examples.en: He was particular about a grand show at his wedding and spent hundreds of thousands.

examples.zh: 过去大户人家出门很讲究排场。
examples.en: In the past, grand families made a great display whenever they went out.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; mildly critical. 讲究 is read jiǎng jiu in speech.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，略带批评；口语中“讲究”读jiǎng jiu。

meaning.en: Setting off or carrying on whatever the weather.
meaning.zh: 不管天气恶劣，坚持前行或工作。

examples.zh: 消防员不顾风雨，连夜赶到现场。
examples.en: The firefighters raced to the scene through the night, storm or no storm.

examples.zh: 他不顾风雨坚持送货。
examples.en: He insisted on making deliveries in all weathers.

usage.en: Verb phrase or adverbial; also figurative for facing difficulty.
usage.zh: 动词性短语或状语，也可比喻不畏艰难。

meaning.en: So tired out that one can hardly bear it.
meaning.zh: 累得受不了。

examples.zh: 连着加了一周班，大家都劳累不堪。
examples.en: After a week of overtime everybody was worn out.

examples.zh: 长途跋涉后，他劳累不堪，倒头就睡。
examples.en: After the long trek he was exhausted and fell asleep as soon as his head hit the pillow.

usage.en: Predicate; 不堪 follows an adjective to mean 'unbearably'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“不堪”接在形容词后表示“到了受不了的程度”。

meaning.en: Brutal and tyrannical, with no regard for justice or the people.
meaning.zh: 凶狠暴虐，不讲道义和人民的死活。

examples.zh: 暴君残暴无道，百姓怨声载道。
examples.en: The tyrant was savage and unjust, and the people cursed him.

examples.zh: 史书记载那位君主残暴无道。
examples.en: The histories record that the ruler was brutal and tyrannical.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical of descriptions of tyrants.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多用于描写暴君。

meaning.en: To lose the trust and support of ordinary people.
meaning.zh: 失去老百姓的信任和拥护。

examples.zh: 政府若不守信，就会失去民心。
examples.en: A government that breaks faith will lose public support.

examples.zh: 这项政策让他彻底失去民心。
examples.en: The policy made him lose all popular backing.

usage.en: Verb–object phrase; its opposite is 得民心 / 深得民心.
usage.zh: 动宾结构；反义为“得民心”“深得民心”。

meaning.en: Standing together, all of one mind.
meaning.zh: 大家团结在一起，想法一致。

examples.zh: 全村人团结同心，终于战胜了洪水。
examples.en: The whole village stood together and finally beat the flood.

examples.zh: 只要团结同心，就没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: As long as we are united, no difficulty is too great.

usage.en: Predicate or imperative slogan; 同心协力 is the better-known fixed form.
usage.zh: 作谓语或口号；更常见的固定说法是“同心协力”。
